# IndieDevUse

> IndieDevUse is a directory of the apps, tools, and technology stacks that indie developers use to build and ship products.

Profiles are either self-submitted or owner-curated from public sources. Profile pages identify their provenance and link to supporting public sources where available.

## Developer directory

- [Indie developer profiles](https://indiedevuse.com/): Browse and search developers, their products, tools, locations, and workflows.
- [Indie developer tech stacks](https://indiedevuse.com/indie-developer-tech-stacks): Compare tools and stack patterns across public IndieDevUse profiles.

## Tools

- [SaaS tech stack generator](https://indiedevuse.com/saas-tech-stack-generator): Build a shareable stack card covering framework, hosting, database, analytics, email, and payments.

## About

- [About IndieDevUse](https://indiedevuse.com/about): Learn how profiles are submitted or curated and how to suggest additions or corrections.
